title: Sweet potatoes with spiced ground beef

items: 4 medium sweet potatoes (about 8 oz each), scrubbed
1 clove garlic, finely grated or minced

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F with a rack in the middle. Line a rimmed sheet pan with foil, since sweet potatoes drip a sticky syrup.
Prick each sweet potato several times with a fork and set it on the pan. Bake 45–60 min, until a knife slides in easily and the skins look puffed and wrinkled.
Make the sauce: stir the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice and salt in a small bowl. Add water 1 Tbsp at a time until it drizzles off a spoon. Chill until serving.

About 15 min before the potatoes are done, heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook 6–8 min, breaking it into small crumbles, until no pink remains and it reads 160°F. Spoon off all but about 1 Tbsp of fat.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper and stir 1 min, until fragrant.
Split each potato lengthwise and fluff the flesh with a fork. Spoon in the beef and drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce.
tips: With bacon, the way she made it in March 2025: cook 4 slices in the skillet first until crisp, brown the beef in 1 Tbsp of the drippings, and crumble the bacon over the top.
Speed it up: microwave the pricked sweet potatoes 8–12 min, turning halfway, until tender.
storage: Fridge up to 4 days, with the beef, potatoes and sauce stored separately. Reheat the beef and potatoes in the microwave until steaming hot (165°F). Serve the sauce cold; it keeps 4 days.
